name: NURS 4230W
title: Quality Improvement and Evidence Based Practice in Nursing
description: Framework for health care system change through evidence-based practice (EBP) and quality improvement (QI). Strategies for implementing evidence-based practice are addressed. QI processes, use of information technology to monitor and evaluate quality indicators, and implementation of strategies to improve outcomes are addressed.
requirement_description: "C" or better in NURS 3234; and ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
